title: 1 July 2025 SST expansion: P.U.(A) 173/2025 and P.U.(A) 170/2025
summary: P.U.(A) 173/2025 restates the general service-tax rate at 8%, substitutes a First Schedule of services that remain at 6% (expanded beyond F&B, telecoms, parking, and logistics to include healthcare, traditional and complementary medicine, allied health, construction, and education, among others), and sets a specific RM25 per card charge. P.U.(A) 170/2025 is the cited instrument for the 10% and 5% sales-tax bands from the same date. The general 8% service-tax figure itself does not change.

legal_basis.title: Perintah Cukai Perkhidmatan (Kadar Cukai) (Pindaan) 2025 / Service Tax (Rate of Tax) (Amendment) Order 2025
legal_basis.instrument: P.U. (A) 173/2025, made under s 10(2) Service Tax Act 2018 [Act 807]; amends P.U. (A) 213/2018
legal_basis.pinpoint: para 1(2) in force 1 Julai 2025; para 3 substituted (general 8%; Jadual Pertama 6%; Jadual Kedua RM25/card)

legal_basis.title: Perintah Cukai Jualan (Kadar Cukai Jualan) 2025 / Sales Tax (Rate of Sales Tax) Order 2025
legal_basis.instrument: P.U. (A) 170/2025, made under s 10(2) Sales Tax Act 2018 [Act 806]
legal_basis.pinpoint: para 1(2) in force 1 Julai 2025; para 2(1) sepuluh peratus on all taxable goods except s 35 exemption orders & non-commercial baggage; para 2(3)(a) Jadual Pertama lima peratus; 2(3)(b) Jadual Kedua specific rates

changes.summary: The 6% service-tax band is restated as the First Schedule of P.U.(A) 173/2025 and is widened beyond F&B, telecommunication, parking, and logistics.

migration_impact.summary: Newly listed First Schedule services move from the general 8% path (or from being out of scope, where the 2025 expansion first brings them in) to 6%. Maintainers must recode those services from 1 July 2025.

changes.summary: Second Schedule specific service tax of RM25 per principal or supplementary credit or charge card, on activation and every 12 months or part.

migration_impact.summary: Card issuers must charge RM25 per card per year under the 2025 Rate Order. A earlier RM25 practice, if any, is not encoded because it was not cited from an opened 2018 order.

after.description: RM25 specific charge per card per year.

changes.summary: P.U.(A) 170/2025 is the opened instrument for a 10% general sales-tax rate and a 5% First Schedule rate from 1 July 2025. This pack does not treat that Order as evidence of the 2018 commencement.

migration_impact.summary: Use 10% and 5% from this Order from 1 July 2025. Do not back-fill 2018 from this citation.
